These require splitting into separate source-claim units.","NYT, CNN, Deseret/AP, BBC, and Al Jazeera are used heavily for overlapping scandal or acquittal claims; duplicated copies and corroborative repetitions should not inflate the evidence estimate.","The notebook treats the labor-reform scandal and the Justice Secretary’s recording as direct ruler-attributable negative evidence without establishing presidential knowledge, direction, benefit, tolerance, obstruction, or corrective responsibility.","The 2001 State Department report and 2001/2002 Freedom House material are largely contextual or post-period;
